name: Hazel & Rye
tagline: Bread, cake and good coffee on Bellevue Road
taxNote: Most bakery food is zero-rated for VAT in the UK.

delivery.note: Round the corner only — three miles, by bike, mornings, still warm.

allergenStatement: It's one small kitchen, and it handles gluten, dairy, egg, nuts, soya and sesame. We can't promise anything is free from them — so tell us about an allergy and we'll talk it through with you.

voice.headline: Your bread's out by half seven.
voice.lede: Order by 11 and it's yours today, and what we have is what we baked this morning.

shopfront.alt: The counter at Hazel & Rye, baskets of bread along the glass and the bench visible behind it
shopfront.caption: Tuesday, about ten past eight.

morning.what: The first mix goes in. Whoever opened turns the lights on and the oven up.
morning.alt: A baker's hands rolling rounds of dough along a floured bench

morning.what: Shaped, panned, and left alone. This is the part that cannot be hurried.
morning.alt: Hands setting proved rolls onto a steel tray

morning.what: Doors. The board goes up, and what is on it is what there is.
morning.alt: A wooden display case, each door lettered by hand in white
